captions: Pella sent a current we can check. I am Talla Three-Wicks. Exchange, Homes and Labyrinth are three paths from the same supply. A bright road is little comfort if one of those paths remains dark.
My aunt counted the lamps from her window and knew which houses were awake after supper. I measure current now; her question about the windows stays with me.
Wake the three conductors beside me in any order. Then tell me whether all three branches hold. We will carry that observation forward without pretending it answers every question.
greeting.repeatText: Wake Exchange, Homes and Labyrinth in any order. Tell me whether their light holds together.

hint:mission:boarman:speech.text: Commit to revise an impossible promise openly. Inspect Wammigmig at 820, 900, listen to the visiting witness, and repair the circuit beside Boarmen Witness.

hint:mission:concordance:branches.text: Meet Talla in Wamwammigtraawsho, wake all three branches and report what the shared current reveals. Meet Talla Three-Wicks. Wake Exchange, Homes and Labyrinth.

captions: I have put your account beside Pella’s. Saima knows it comes from me. The Measured Oasis is your next stop.
She may doubt what a few repaired relays can prove about a whole network. That is a fair question. Let her see the work, and listen to what the tables missed.

choices.text: I’ll bring the account to Saima

story-complete.repeatText: Saima is waiting at the Measured Oasis. Bring the three readings, and leave room for her questions.

pending.text: There is still a branch to check.

captions: All three branches hold. Orro’s road light, Pella’s returning pulse, and this shared supply now belong in the same account.
Saima of Nine Measures keeps the public tables at Migbushoprahshotra, the Measured Oasis. A pulse there falls outside her prediction. She will want readings, not a traveler’s grand theory.
Bring her these three branches and tell her how you checked them. If her test disagrees with us, bring the disagreement too.

not-yet.text: I can test these three branches when Pella has restored the returning current. Help her with the listening coil first; then we will know what supply we share.

local-work.text: We can keep that local task alongside the journey. Which part do you want to discuss?
